title: Corner-to-Center Maze Paths

examples.explanation: Start at the top-left corner, jump right once, then down once to the center. Other corners cannot move.

inputFormat: maze is a nonempty n × n matrix with odd n. Each entry is a nonnegative integer jump length.
outputFormat: Return an array of paths. Each path is an ordered array of zero-based [row, column] coordinates, including its corner and the center. Path order does not matter; do not duplicate paths.
